name: PL-any-status-holds
note: A declined card, a former patron and a member who never pledged would all hold the tier their last payment named.

name: PL-unmapped-tier-holds
note: Any pledge at all - a tier the config never named - would be a Disciple.

name: PL-handle-guard-dropped
note: A row with no handle - a guest's, one storage clear from gone - would hold a pledge's title.

name: PL-pledge-not-read
note: The handle lists alone again: every patron a message to Mac and a deploy, the workflow this ends.

name: PL-title-outside-three
note: A tier mapped to the Dungeon Master or a one-player title would sell what is granted by name.

name: PL-malformed-entry
note: An entry with a third part read as if it had two.

name: PL-md5-a-rounds-shift
note: One shift off: every webhook's signature refused.

name: PL-md5-the-length-word
note: The length in bytes where RFC 1321 says bits.

name: PL-hmac-the-key-block
note: A long key cut where RFC 2104 hashes it.

name: PL-compare-skipped
note: Any 32 hex digits a signature: anyone could tell the service a member pledged.

name: PL-case-read
note: Patreon's hex in capitals refused.

name: PL-one-key-for-both-kinds
note: One key for both kinds: a state - which the account read hands every registered player - opens as a confirm's ticket.

name: PL-expiry-not-read
note: A link or a ticket good for ever.

name: PL-account-not-required
note: A sealed value naming no account opened as one.

name: PL-missing-status-null
old: const status = attrs && typeof attrs === 'object' && 'patron_status' in attrs
note: A payload that leaves the status out read as no status - a patron's title lapsed by a webhook that did not mention it.

name: PL-missing-tiers-none
note: A payload that leaves the tiers out read as none.

name: PL-guest-given-link
old: const state = registered ? await sealPatreon('state', { p: player.id, x: nowS + PATREON_STATE_S }, env, { subtle, rand }) : null;
new: const state = await sealPatreon('state', { p: player.id, x: nowS + PATREON_STATE_S }, env, { subtle, rand });
note: A guest offered a link the confirm can never finish.

name: PL-secret-in-url
note: The client secret in every authorize URL - in every player's browser history.

name: PL-on-while-off
note: The card offered a link while the client is not configured.

name: PL-callback-links
old: const from = await db.prepare('SELECT handle FROM players WHERE patreon_user = ?1 AND id <> ?2').bind(who.user, player.id).first();
new:
await linkPatreon(ctx, { p: player.id, u: who.user, t: who.tiers.join(','), s: who.status });
          const from = await db.prepare('SELECT handle FROM players WHERE patreon_user = ?1 AND id <> ?2').bind(who.user, player.id).first();
note: The link written before the patron reads which game account: a link another player started is finished by the patron's Allow.

name: PL-confirm-never-writes
old: const r = await linkPatreon(ctx, { p: ticket.p, u: who.user, t: who.tiers.join(','), s: who.status });
note: A yes that links nothing.

name: PL-confirm-trusts-the-page
new: const who = { user: ticket.u, name: '', tiers: ['1001'], status: 'active_patron' };
note: The yes writes what the page showed: a pledge cancelled before the press - or a yes pressed again after it - keeps a title no webhook will ever lapse.

name: PL-patreon-account-not-compared
old: if (who.user !== ticket.u) return page(PATREON_PAGES.expired, 400);   // the token answers for another Patreon account now
note: The page named one Patreon account and the yes links another.

name: PL-redirect-differs
old: const token = await patreonExchange(outbound, env, code, `${url.origin}${PATREON_CALLBACK_PATH}`);
new: const token = await patreonExchange(outbound, env, code, `${url.origin}${PATREON_CALLBACK_PATH}/`);
note: Patreon refuses a code spent with a redirect it was not authorized for.

name: PL-signature-not-checked
note: Anybody's POST is Patreon's word on a member.

name: PL-ended-keeps-tiers
old: const tiers = ended ? '' : (m.tiers === undefined ? null : m.tiers.join(','));
new: const tiers = m.tiers === undefined ? null : m.tiers.join(',');
note: A deleted pledge whose payload still lists the tier it paid through.

name: PL-stated-field-skipped
note: A declined card never written: the title held while unpaid.

name: PL-unstated-cleared
note: A payload that leaves the tiers out clears them.

name: PL-the-move-not-made
old: WHERE patreon_user = ?1 AND id <> ?2 AND ${registered}`).bind(c.u, c.p),
new: WHERE 0 AND patreon_user = ?1 AND id <> ?2 AND ${registered}`).bind(c.u, c.p),
note: The other account keeps it: the UNIQUE index refuses the link, and a patron with a new game account cannot take their title along.

name: PL-page-silent-move
old: ...(from ? [`This Patreon is linked to ${from} now. Linking moves it to ${handle}.`] : []),
note: The move made without a word on the page that asks.

name: PL-unlink-keeps
old: await db.prepare('UPDATE players SET patreon_user = NULL, patreon_tiers = NULL, patreon_status = NULL, patreon_at = NULL WHERE id = ?1')
new: await db.prepare('UPDATE players SET patreon_at = NULL WHERE id = ?1')
note: Unlink answers unlinked and keeps the pledge.

name: PL-declined-asks
note: A no on Patreon sent to Patreon's token endpoint anyway.

name: PL-failed-exchange-goes-on
note: A code Patreon refused carried on to the identity.

name: PL-ticket-not-opened
note: A forged ticket reaches the write.

name: PL-name-unescaped
note: A Patreon name of <script> runs on the service's own origin.

name: PL-policy-dropped
note: The confirm page framed, its button clicked under another page.

name: PL-refresh-never-reads
old: if (!r || !r.ok || self.stage !== 'in' || secret() !== asked) return false;   // signed out, a blip, or another account since
note: Back from Patreon to a card that still offers Link Patreon.

name: PL-note-never-linked
note: The card never says the link landed.

name: PL-unlink-patches
old: self.wardrobe = { ...(self.wardrobe ?? {}), titles: r.data.titles, title: r.data.title, glyphs: r.data.glyphs, ...glyphHalf(r.data), ...auraHalf(r.data) };   // the service's word whole: a tier's title gone with the link
note: The card keeps a title the service says is gone.

name: PL-row-for-guest
note: A guest offered a row it can do nothing with.

name: PL-row-while-off
note: The row drawn while linking is off.

name: PL-link-not-link
old: const a = keyedAs(el('a', 'act', p.linked ? t('account.patreon.refresh', 'Refresh') : t('account.patreon.link', 'Link Patreon')), 'patreon:link');
new: const a = keyedAs(el('button', 'act', p.linked ? t('account.patreon.refresh', 'Refresh') : t('account.patreon.link', 'Link Patreon')), 'patreon:link');
note: A button with an href goes nowhere.

name: PL-no-read-back
note: Back from the browser to a card that does not know.

name: PL-listener-outlives
note: Every card ever drawn listening for ever.

name: PL-secret-as-var
note: A var of the secret's name: Cloudflare refuses the secret its binding. HIEROPHANT-TIER (re-aimed by content): the line gained the Hierophant tier.

name: PL-a-tier-mapped-mac-did-not-name
note: Mac: "Supporter doesnt recieve a title/glyph" - a Supporter would wear the Disciple's. HIEROPHANT-TIER (re-aimed): it mapped the Hierophant tier, which Mac named on 2026-10-17 ("The $50 patreon tier doesnt have a title/glyph ingame. The Heirophant").

name: PL-the-hierophant-tier-unmapped
note: HIEROPHANT-TIER: Mac's $50 patrons hold nothing by their pledge again.

name: PL-secrets-echoed
old: echo "neither PATREON_CLIENT_SECRET nor PATREON_WEBHOOK_SECRET is set for this repository - Patreon linking stays off"
note: A secret in the run's log.
